item.title: Drones over base where Rubio, Hegseth live raise security concerns
item.summary: Lockdowns at U.S. bases and a global security alert underscore concerns that Iranian retaliation could extend to officials on American soil.

item.title: Vance is in a bind, supporting a war that could cost him politically
item.summary: People close to JD Vance concede that a long conflict will be a challenge for the next GOP nominee but say the vice president hasn’t made up his mind about running.

item.title: Republicans are ramping up attacks on Muslims — and getting rewarded
item.summary: Past GOP leaders, including George W. Bush, spoke out against Islamophobia. Now it is going unchallenged.

item.title: Supreme Court to consider whether Trump can end protected status for Syrians, Haitians
item.summary: A decision by the Supreme Court could affect other challenges to the government’s efforts to end temporary protected status for hundreds of thousands of migrants.

item.title: Trump administration asks Congress to block state limits on AI
item.summary: White House advisers aim to codify policies to protect AI companies’ interests, despite past opposition from many Republican governors and influencers.

item.title: Tracking who Trump is appointing to fill key administration roles
item.summary: Follow President Trump’s progress filling over 800 positions, among about 1,300 that require Senate confirmation, in this tracker from The Washington Post and the Partnership for Public Service.

item.title: Trump breaches fire wall between watchdogs and agencies they investigate
item.summary: Inspectors general are subject to growing partisan pressures as the White House and political figures seek greater influence over them than ever before.

item.title: House Republicans subpoena prosecutor for records tied to Stephen Miller protester
item.summary: The demand comes after Rep. Jim Jordan, chairman of the House Judiciary Committee, opened an inquiry into Parisa Dehghani-Tafti, Arlington County’s lead prosecutor.

item.title: Trump orders TV networks to protect Army-Navy football game
item.summary: The president wants to grant an exclusive broadcast window for the game, which faces scheduling pressure.

item.title: They defended the Capitol on Jan. 6. Their names are missing from the tribute.
item.summary: A Washington Post review found at least 16 D.C. police officers who faced the violent mob are omitted from a personnel list displayed at the U.S. Capitol.
